Task: Text Content Safety

Write code that scores user text for unsafe or policy-violating content using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Content Moderation:
  Service: Alibaba Content Moderation
  SDK: alibabacloud_green
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: text/scan
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/331920.html

Option 2 — Perspective API:
  Service: Perspective API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: comments:analyze
  Setup hints: PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.perspectiveapi.com/s/

Option 3 — Tisane:
  Service: Tisane Text Moderation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /parse
  Setup hints: TISANE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.tisane.ai/

Option 4 — watsonx guardrails:
  Service: watsonx.ai guardrails / HAP detection
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: HAP detection, text detection
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/watsonxdata/premium/2.3.x?topic=prompts-removing-harmful-content

Option 5 — Azure AI Content Safety:
  Service: Azure AI Content Safety
  SDK: requests / azure-ai-contentsafety
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: analyze_text
  Setup hints: AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT, AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-safety/overview

Option 6 — Amazon Comprehend Toxicity / Bedrock Guardrails:
  Service: Amazon Comprehend / Bedrock Guardrails
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_toxic_content, apply_guardrail
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/trust-safety.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import requests


PERSPECTIVE_API_URL = "https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze"
DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES = [
    "TOXICITY",
    "SEVERE_TOXICITY",
    "IDENTITY_ATTACK",
    "INSULT",
    "PROFANITY",
    "THREAT",
    "SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT",
    "FLIRTATION",
]


class PerspectiveModerationError(Exception):
    pass


def score_text_safety(
    text: str,
    *,
    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
    languages: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    attributes: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    do_not_store: bool = True,
    timeout: float = 20.0,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        raise ValueError("text must be a non-empty string")

    api_key = api_key or os.getenv("PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise PerspectiveModerationError("Missing Perspective API key. Set PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY.")

    selected_attributes = attributes or DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES
    requested_attributes = {name: {} for name in selected_attributes}

    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "comment": {"text": text},
        "requestedAttributes": requested_attributes,
        "doNotStore": do_not_store,
    }
    if languages:
        payload["languages"] = languages

    response = requests.post(
        PERSPECTIVE_API_URL,
        params={"key": api_key},
        json=payload,
        timeout=timeout,
    )

    try:
        data = response.json()
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise PerspectiveModerationError(
            f"Perspective API returned non-JSON response: {response.text[:500]}"
        ) from exc

    if response.status_code >= 400:
        message = data.get("error", {}).get("message") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        raise PerspectiveModerationError(
            f"Perspective API error {response.status_code}: {message or data}"
        )

    attribute_scores = data.get("attributeScores", {})
    scores: Dict[str, float] = {}
    spans: Dict[str, Any] = {}

    for attr_name, attr_data in attribute_scores.items():
        summary_score = (
            attr_data.get("summaryScore", {}).get("value")
            if isinstance(attr_data, dict)
            else None
        )
        if summary_score is not None:
            scores[attr_name] = float(summary_score)

        span_scores = attr_data.get("spanScores", []) if isinstance(attr_data, dict) else []
        if span_scores:
            spans[attr_name] = span_scores

    overall_max = max(scores.values()) if scores else 0.0
    flagged_attributes = sorted([name for name, value in scores.items() if value >= 0.7])

    return {
        "provider": "Perspective API",
        "model_family": "commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1",
        "text": text,
        "language": data.get("detectedLanguages", languages or []),
        "scores": scores,
        "overall_score": overall_max,
        "flagged": bool(flagged_attributes),
        "flagged_attributes": flagged_attributes,
        "span_scores": spans,
        "raw_response": data,
    }
